title: Calibration-with-Graduation-Trigger Pattern
statement: A methodology amendment at a named workflow point specifies a calibration mechanism, a tier classification (Skill-Structure Layer or Tier-2 felt-trigger), an audit-bearing artifact that records the mechanism's operation, and a graduation trigger stating the multi-cycle evidence that promotes or relaxes the mechanism.
summary: The one decision-structure the five Cycle 019 ADRs each instantiate: workflow point + calibration mechanism + tier + audit-bearing artifact + graduation trigger.
caveats: Also applied by ADR-083 (Cycle 017) and ADR-091 (Cycle 018); the five-ADR clustering at one level did not recur in Cycles 017 and 018 (Grounding Loop 4), so its topology-level diagnostic value is single-cycle evidence.
Inherits the kitchen-sink caveat (Essay-Outline 020 C7): diagnostic value depends on producing actionable distinctions at artifact-creation moments.
provenance: Essay-Outline 020 C1; research log Loop 1; spike-020.
